query: Migrate this Veeva story to Salesforce LSC: 'As a Field Rep, I need a Sample Inventory screen in the Veeva app to view my on-hand sample lots and initiate sample orders, so I can manage inventory and stay PDMA compliant.' Priority P0.
expected_behavior: Detects Veeva to LSC Migration mode and reads the veeva-to-lsc-mapping reference before generating

Translates Veeva terms to LSC-native in the story body (Sample Management/Sample lots -> Product Item / Production Batch Item; Sample Order -> Sample Order/Product Request); no 'Veeva' wording remains in the story body
Records the original Veeva feature in a 'Veeva Source' header field
Uses the concrete persona 'Field Sales Representative' — never 'user', 'business user', or 'HCP' as the login persona
Acceptance Criteria use Pattern A (three explicit GWT lines, one When each) with at least one happy path and one edge case (e.g. expired lot)
No Apex class names, IP version/step numbers, SOQL, or API field names inside any Given/When/Then/And line
Includes a '## Technical Implementation (high-level)' section after the ACs that cross-references AC numbers
Marks greenfield LSC components as 'Proposed' and/or raises a Clarification Question about whether the LSC package/data model is installed (PNM workspace)
Includes Definition of done checklist and an Estimated Effort table with S/M/L/XL/XXL sizing labelled AI-estimated
Proposes saving the story under requirements/<PascalCase>.md
